# Google Sheets KPI tracker

*Client industry: B2B services | Completed: 2024-05-10 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p07*

## The problem
The client was a small agency tracking KPIs in ten disconnected sheets.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Google Sheets, a free Google dashboard tool. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project gave the founder a one-page live KPI view.
